prompt.intro: You are shown two screenshots, labelled Image A and Image B; each is from Duneglide, a browser 3D arcade game. They may come from the same game or from two different games made with the same engine, with any on-screen HUD hidden or kept. Judge only what is visible: sky, ground, scenery, lighting, palette, glow, materials, characters or vehicles, camera and HUD style. Question: are these two frames from the same game?
prompt.question: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, with these keys: "same_game": true if both frames come from the same game, false if they come from two different games; "same_game_confidence": a number from 0 to 1, how sure you are of your same_game answer; "tells": up to three short phrases naming the visible cues that drove your answer.
